How a commission works

01

Tell us what you're picturing

A screenshot, a sketch, a stone you already own, or a heirloom you want reset. Rough is fine — most people start with rough.

02

We quote the stone and the setting

You see the diamond specs and the metal cost separately, so you know exactly what you're paying for before anything is cast.

03

Set, finished, and photographed

Four to six weeks for most pieces. You get the shots of your piece before it ships — they're yours to keep.

Why the photos look like this

We shoot every piece ourselves.

No stock renders and no borrowed catalog images. What's on this page is what left the bench — same stones, same setting, same finish.

It's also how we hand a piece over. Before it ships you get a full set of images, lit the way the stone actually behaves.

Talk to us about a piece

New pieces, when they're finished

One email when a commission is worth showing. Nothing else, ever.
